items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: O'Neil Spencer who was listed as a drummer on there... the only people that Kirby had with him at the time were Buster Bailey and O'Neil Spencer... Russell Procope and Billy Kyle, Charlie Shavers and O'Neil Spencer came in off the road

ctx.x: Leo Watson, yes. So I think it was Frankie Newton's band up to the point when Kirby took over, see.
Because -- now O'Neil Spencer who was listed as a drummer on there -- Lucky Millinder's band was out of New York at the time. They were on the road. And when --
